title: AI Product Photo Generator for Sellers | Aidreamcapes
description: Try an AI product photo generator for sellers: turn one picture into white background, lifestyle, or on-model shots for your store. Upload your first photo.
h1: AI Product Photo Generator: New Shots From One Photo
lead: Upload one product photo, pick a template or describe the scene, and get a fresh square image for your listings, store, and social posts.
intro: This is where every Aidreamcapes photo tool starts. Upload one photo of your product, then either pick a template or write a short description of the shot you want. You get back a new product image, square by default, that you can download and use right away. Your original photo and every result stay private in your account.

It's built for small store owners who need more than one picture per product but don't have time to book a shoot. From a single phone photo you can make a clean white background shot, place the item on a kitchen counter or a beach towel, show it on a model, or set up a close-up of the stitching. A good order is the main listing photo first, then scenes that help shoppers picture the product in their own home.

benefits.d: Use the same product photo again with different templates or descriptions. There's no reshoot each time you want a new setting.
Pick a ready-made look when you want a quick start. Write your own description when you have a specific scene in mind.
Uploads and finished images are visible only to you. Nothing goes into a public gallery.

steps.d: A well-lit shot with the whole product in frame gives the cleanest result. Your phone camera is enough.

steps.t: Pick a template or describe it
steps.d: Choose a look such as white background or lifestyle scene, or write a line like “ceramic mug on a wooden table by a window.”
Save the square image to your computer, or change the template or wording and make a new one.

uses.d: Add lifestyle and detail shots under your main image so shoppers can see the product in use.
Fill the extra image slots after your main photo with scenes, close-ups, and size references.
Square images fit the feed without cropping, for regular posts and feed ads alike.
Drop a fresh product scene into your next launch or restock email instead of reusing the same old photo.

faq.q: What kinds of product photos can I make?
faq.a: White background shots, lifestyle scenes, on-model photos, new backgrounds, feed ad images, and close-ups such as color variants or what's in the box. Each one starts from a photo of your product.

faq.q: What kind of photo should I upload?
faq.a: Use a sharp photo where the whole product is visible and nothing is cut off at the edges. Even light and a plain background help, but a clear phone photo works too.

faq.q: Can I use these photos as my Amazon main image?
faq.a: Use the white background option for that slot. Amazon's main image rules call for a pure white background with no added text, graphics, or watermarks, so compare your result with Amazon's current requirements before you upload it.

faq.q: Can I put a price or sale text on the photo?
faq.a: Add text after you download. Canva works well for prices, discount codes, and headlines. AI-generated lettering can contain typos, so typing it yourself keeps it accurate.
